purpose.text: Every 10 minutes, read main HEAD from GitHub and the push/main workflow runs for exactly that SHA (GET-only gh api), and write one receipt: per required workflow (agent-governance, cio-production-hardening-ci, release-readiness; the promote gate's set) SUCCESS | FAILURE | PENDING | MISSING and one overall state. The Releases & schedules page shows it with its age; it never acts.
purpose.source: scripts/main_ci_watch.py; operator 2026-10-22 (Releases page: main CI UNAVAILABLE)

connects_to.name: GitHub API through the gh CLI (GET repos/<slug>/commits/main, GET actions/runs?head_sha=…&event=push&branch=main)

healthy.text: at shadow every fire runs --dry-run: RUN_DONE mode dry_run, no receipt
after promotion: every fire ends RUN_DONE in mode live

degraded.text: ok_at older than 20 min but younger than 30 min

failed.text: exit 1, receipt ok false (dependency_unavailable), ok_at carried forward; the page shows 'last run failed at …'
an exit-0 live run produced fewer than 3 workflow rows

baseline.source: one read-only --dry-run 2026-10-22 22:05 ET took about 2 s

alerting.severity_basis: a missed fire delays a page cell, never a trade
alerting.routing: SIEM row n8n:<lane> by scripts/n8n_siem_bridge.py; no operator intent. Never PAGE.

remediation.note: not in the remediation catalogue; a person re-runs or fixes gh auth. Runbook: docs/ops/RELEASES_SCHEDULES_PAGE.md.

evidence.never: an n8n execution status; prove work with the ledger and the receipt

state_note: Agent-written 2026-10-22, NOT registered: an agent never marks a contract REVIEWED (AGENTS.md §23.19). Owner reviews, then one PR adds this contract (REVIEWED), the registry row and the allowlist entry at shadow.
